name: hw12_12_statistics_order
description: Test 12 (HW5, HW11). At 24-bit precision, points at from, from + 1 and from + 3 with values 0, 1 and 1: GetTrend gives slope 0x3E924922 and intercept 0x3E924928 (dividing by sx and sy instead of multiplying by the rounded reciprocals would give 0x3E924924 and 0x3E924925). With values 0, 3 and 8: slope 0x40292492 and intercept 0x3E12492B. The values are the spec's, computed from the rounding rules of 4.7.
